SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT. All people and places are fictional. Not a legal record.
DEED OF ABSOLUTE SALE
THIS DEED OF ABSOLUTE SALE is made at Harinagar on this the 7th day of June, 2022 by Mr.
Gopal Krishna Iyer, son of K. Narayana Iyer, aged about 61 years, residing at 8 Lake View Road,
Harinagar, hereinafter referred to as the SELLER, in favour of Mrs. Farida Khan, wife of Imran
Khan, aged about 38 years, residing at 77 Park Street, Harinagar, hereinafter referred to as the
PURCHASER.
WHEREAS the Seller is the absolute owner of the land bearing Survey No. 91/3B situated at
Greenfield Layout, Harinagar, having acquired it under a registered gift deed dated 14 February
2005.
In consideration of a sum of Rs.30,50,000 paid by the Purchaser, the Seller hereby conveys the
said land measuring 2400 sq. ft. to the Purchaser.
The land is bounded on the North by a 40 ft road, on the South by the property of Lata Menon,
on the East by Site No. 12, and on the West by Site No. 14.
Presented for registration on 9 June 2022 before the Sub-Registrar, Greenfield and registered as
Serial No. 7781 of 2022 in Book I.
